method: Per-case idle rate times measured transfer interval. Background may drift; counter snapshots are sequential and include observer/driver traffic. No per-TLP opcode, requester ID or physical trace.
inference: Internal Ada-executed 1MiB operations show little excess at the USB4 host PCIe ingress and dock lane. External A2000-executed operations show much larger excess, including failed PULLs. Compatible with a requester/driver/host-fabric failure before host USB4 ingress for Ada operations; does not locate it uniquely.
dock_pcie_counter_limit: Zero even for correct CPU MMIO and successful external-GPU PUSH. Must not be treated as absence of packets.
